title: How Dossie Handles E-Signatures
meta_title: How Dossie Sends Documents for E-Signature — Dossie
meta_description: Send a document for signature without leaving Dossie. Role-based prefill puts the right fields in front of the buyer's agent or seller's agent automatically.
deck: Send for signature without leaving Dossie. Role-based prefill means the right fields land in front of the right party, every time.
image_alt: Sending a document for e-signature directly from Dossie
image_caption: The Send for Signature modal, mid-flow — recipients and fields already placed.
related_blurb: Send for Signature in two clicks, with role-based prefill for buyer's agent vs. seller's agent.
intro_html: Once a document needs a signature, Dossie sends it — no separate e-sign tool, no exporting and re-uploading. Recipients and signature fields are placed automatically based on their role in the deal.

steps.p: Any document already in the dossier — amendment, addendum, disclosure — can be sent for signature directly, in the same place it lives.
Dossie knows who's the buyer's agent and who's the seller's agent on this file, and prefills the right recipient with the right fields — no manually dragging signature boxes onto a PDF.
The signed document lands back in the dossier automatically once every party has signed — no separate download-and-reupload step.

callout: Field placement follows the role, not a template guess — the buyer's agent and seller's agent each get exactly the fields that belong to them.
cta_title: Stop juggling a separate e-sign tool.
cta_sub: Dossie sends, tracks, and files signed documents without ever leaving the dossier. Built for Texas agents.

faq.q: Do I need a separate e-signature account to use this?
faq.a: No — Send for Signature runs inside Dossie. There's no separate tool to log into or export documents to.

Dossie already knows who's the buyer's agent and who's the seller's agent on a file, so it prefills the correct recipient and signature fields automatically instead of requiring manual field placement.
